waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Only citations and page furniture use 9–10pt; decision content remains 12pt or larger and is checked in the Office render.
waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: Muted citations and dark-slide furniture are intentionally secondary and are checked in the Office render.
waivers.TEXT_OVERFLOW_RISK: All data-dependent and long-title boxes use PowerPoint shrink-to-fit; the real Office render is inspected for clipping.
waivers.SLIDE_SHAPE_COUNT: Native editable scorecards and matrices may exceed the generic shape threshold; collision and overflow QA remains mandatory.
waivers.DECK_COLOR_COUNT: The branded palette plus template theme colors exceeds the generic count; only the governed navy, teal, gold, coral, neutral, and theme colors are used.
